title: Mr C Residences header
description: On phones a fixed 62px brick-red bar with a light wordmark lockup at the left and 'MENU' plus a three-line burger at the right, which slides a full-height red menu of uppercase links in from the right. On desktop it lies over the top of the hero: the lockup top-left and a right-aligned column of ten small SemiBold uppercase links closed by a thin vertical rule, each link drawing an underline in from the left on hover.
notes: phones: fixed bar (62px); the first section should leave 62px for it (mrcresidencesbocaraton-hero does)
desktop: absolute over the first section, white text, so that section should be dark media
the mark slot takes a small logo; empty, a lucide glass icon stands in
name: mrcresidencesbocaraton-header
